functions.name: opus_strerror
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT const char *opus_strerror(int error);
functions.description: Converts an Opus error code to a human-readable string. Use this to log or display descriptive messages corresponding to return codes from Opus APIs. Returns a pointer to a constant, null-terminated string describing the error.
requirements: error: any int value is accepted; typically pass an Opus error code such as OPUS_OK, OPUS_BAD_ARG, etc.
The returned pointer refers to a constant string; do not modify or free it (inferred from return type and common library pattern).

functions.name: opus_get_version_string
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT const char *opus_get_version_string(void);
functions.description: Returns the libopus version string for the linked library at runtime. Applications can check for the substring "-fixed" to distinguish fixed-point from floating-point builds.
requirements: No arguments required.
The returned pointer refers to a constant string; do not modify or free it (inferred from return type and common library pattern).

functions.name: opus_encoder_get_size
functions.signature: int opus_encoder_get_size(int channels);
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to hold an OpusEncoder state for the specified channel count. Used to allocate memory when not using opus_encoder_create.
requirements: channels must be 1 or 2

functions.name: opus_encoder_create
functions.signature: OpusEncoder *opus_encoder_create(opus_int32 Fs, int channels, int application, int *error);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a new OpusEncoder for the given sample rate, channel count, and application (coding mode). On success, returns a pointer to the encoder and writes OPUS_OK to error; on failure, returns NULL and writes an error code.
requirements: channels must be 1 or 2
application must be one of OPUS_APPLICATION_VOIP, OPUS_APPLICATION_AUDIO, or OPUS_APPLICATION_RESTRICTED_LOWDELAY
error must be a valid pointer if error reporting is desired
A single encoder state must not be used for more than one stream at the same time

functions.name: opus_encoder_init
functions.signature: int opus_encoder_init(OpusEncoder *st, opus_int32 Fs, int channels, int application);
functions.description: Initializes a previously-allocated OpusEncoder object with the specified sample rate, channels, and application. Returns OPUS_OK on success or an error code.
requirements: st must point to memory at least opus_encoder_get_size(channels) bytes
channels must be 1 or 2
application must be one of OPUS_APPLICATION_VOIP, OPUS_APPLICATION_AUDIO, or OPUS_APPLICATION_RESTRICTED_LOWDELAY
Use OPUS_RESET_STATE CTL to reset a previously initialized state

functions.name: opus_encode
functions.signature: opus_int32 opus_encode(OpusEncoder *st, const opus_int16 *pcm, int frame_size, unsigned char *data, opus_int32 max_data_bytes);
functions.description: Encodes one Opus frame from 16-bit interleaved PCM input into the provided output buffer. Returns the number of bytes in the encoded packet or a negative error code.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized OpusEncoder
pcm must point to frame_size*channels samples of 16-bit PCM (interleaved if 2 channels)
frame_size must be a valid Opus frame size for the encoder's sampling rate (e.g., at 48 kHz: 120, 240, 480, 960, 1920, 2880)
data must have at least max_data_bytes bytes available
max_data_bytes must be sufficient for the target bitrate; function returns <0 on failure
Providing less than 10 ms will prevent the encoder from using LPC or hybrid modes

functions.name: opus_encode24
functions.signature: opus_int32 opus_encode24(OpusEncoder *st, const opus_int32 *pcm, int frame_size, unsigned char *data, opus_int32 max_data_bytes);
functions.description: Encodes one Opus frame from 24-bit-range PCM held in 32-bit integers into the provided output buffer. Returns the number of bytes in the encoded packet or a negative error code.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized OpusEncoder
pcm must point to frame_size*channels samples of 32-bit integers representing (or slightly exceeding) 24-bit values (interleaved if 2 channels)
frame_size must be a valid Opus frame size for the encoder's sampling rate
data must have at least max_data_bytes bytes available
Providing less than 10 ms will prevent the encoder from using LPC or hybrid modes

functions.name: opus_encode_float
functions.signature: opus_int32 opus_encode_float(OpusEncoder *st, const float *pcm, int frame_size, unsigned char *data, opus_int32 max_data_bytes);
functions.description: Encodes one Opus frame from interleaved floating-point PCM input into the provided output buffer. Returns the number of bytes in the encoded packet or a negative error code.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized OpusEncoder
pcm must point to frame_size*channels floats, normal range ±1.0 (values beyond ±1.0 are allowed but may be clipped by integer decoders)
frame_size must be a valid Opus frame size for the encoder's sampling rate
data must have at least max_data_bytes bytes available
Providing less than 10 ms will prevent the encoder from using LPC or hybrid modes

functions.name: opus_encoder_destroy
functions.signature: void opus_encoder_destroy(OpusEncoder *st);
functions.description: Frees an OpusEncoder previously allocated by opus_encoder_create.
requirements: st must be a pointer returned by opus_encoder_create or NULL
Do not call on memory initialized only via opus_encoder_init unless you allocated it accordingly; freeing such memory is the caller’s responsibility

functions.name: opus_encoder_ctl
functions.signature: int opus_encoder_ctl(OpusEncoder *st, int request, ...);
functions.description: Issues a control (CTL) request on an OpusEncoder to set or query encoder parameters using convenience macros from opus_genericctls or opus_encoderctls. Returns OPUS_OK or an error code.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized OpusEncoder
request and variadic arguments must match one of the documented CTL macros in opus_genericctls or opus_encoderctls
Most parameters can be set or changed at any time during a stream unless otherwise documented

functions.name: opus_decoder_get_size
functions.signature: int opus_decoder_get_size(int channels);
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to hold an OpusDecoder state for the specified channel count. Used to allocate memory when not using opus_decoder_create.
requirements: channels must be 1 or 2

functions.name: opus_decoder_create
functions.signature: OpusDecoder *opus_decoder_create(opus_int32 Fs, int channels, int *error);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a new OpusDecoder for the given sample rate and channel count. Returns a pointer to the decoder and writes OPUS_OK to error on success; returns NULL with an error code on failure.
requirements: channels must be 1 or 2
error must be a valid pointer if error reporting is desired
Packets must be decoded serially and in order with this state
A single decoder state may only be accessed from a single thread at a time

functions.name: opus_decoder_init
functions.signature: int opus_decoder_init(OpusDecoder *st, opus_int32 Fs, int channels);
functions.description: Initializes a previously-allocated OpusDecoder object with the specified output sample rate and channel count. Returns OPUS_OK on success or an error code.
requirements: st must point to memory at least opus_decoder_get_size(channels) bytes
channels must be 1 or 2
Use OPUS_RESET_STATE CTL to reset a previously initialized state

functions.name: opus_decode
functions.signature: int opus_decode(OpusDecoder *st, const unsigned char *data, opus_int32 len, opus_int16 *pcm, int frame_size, int decode_fec);
functions.description: Decodes an Opus packet to 16-bit interleaved PCM. Supports packet loss concealment when data is NULL and optional FEC using decode_fec=1. Returns decoded samples per channel or a negative error code.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized OpusDecoder
data points to the input payload and may be NULL to indicate packet loss
len is the number of bytes in data (ignored when data is NULL)
pcm must have space for frame_size*channels samples
frame_size must be >= required decoded duration; if less than max packet duration (120 ms; 5760 at 48 kHz), some packets cannot be decoded
For PLC (data==NULL) or FEC (decode_fec==1), frame_size must equal the duration of audio that is missing and must be a multiple of 2.5 ms
decode_fec must be 0 or 1

functions.name: opus_decode24
functions.signature: int opus_decode24(OpusDecoder *st, const unsigned char *data, opus_int32 len, opus_int32 *pcm, int frame_size, int decode_fec);
functions.description: Decodes an Opus packet to 24-bit-range audio stored in 32-bit integers. Supports packet loss concealment and optional FEC. Returns decoded samples (per channel) or a negative error code.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized OpusDecoder
data points to the input payload and may be NULL to indicate packet loss
len is the number of bytes in data (ignored when data is NULL)
pcm must have space for frame_size*channels 32-bit samples
frame_size constraints identical to opus_decode (including PLC/FEC rules and 2.5 ms multiple)
decode_fec must be 0 or 1

functions.name: opus_decode_float
functions.signature: int opus_decode_float(OpusDecoder *st, const unsigned char *data, opus_int32 len, float *pcm, int frame_size, int decode_fec);
functions.description: Decodes an Opus packet to interleaved floating-point PCM. Supports packet loss concealment and optional FEC. Returns decoded samples per channel or a negative error code.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized OpusDecoder
data may be NULL to indicate packet loss
len is the number of bytes in data (ignored when data is NULL)
pcm must have space for frame_size*channels floats
frame_size constraints identical to opus_decode (including PLC/FEC rules and 2.5 ms multiple)
decode_fec must be 0 or 1

functions.name: opus_decoder_ctl
functions.signature: int opus_decoder_ctl(OpusDecoder *st, int request, ...);
functions.description: Issues a control (CTL) request on an OpusDecoder to set or query decoder parameters using convenience macros from opus_genericctls or opus_decoderctls. Returns OPUS_OK or an error code.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized OpusDecoder
request and variadic arguments must match one of the documented CTL macros in opus_genericctls or opus_decoderctls
Packets must be decoded serially and in order with a given state; threading constraints apply to the decoder state

functions.name: opus_decoder_destroy
functions.signature: void opus_decoder_destroy(OpusDecoder *st);
functions.description: Frees an OpusDecoder previously allocated by opus_decoder_create.
requirements: st must be a pointer returned by opus_decoder_create or NULL
Do not call on memory initialized only via opus_decoder_init unless you allocated it accordingly; freeing such memory is the caller’s responsibility

functions.name: opus_dred_decoder_get_size
functions.signature: int opus_dred_decoder_get_size(void);
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to hold an OpusDREDDecoder state.

functions.name: opus_dred_decoder_create
functions.signature: OpusDREDDecoder *opus_dred_decoder_create(int *error);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes an OpusDREDDecoder. Returns a pointer to the decoder and writes OPUS_OK to error on success; returns NULL with an error code on failure.
requirements: error must be a valid pointer if error reporting is desired

functions.name: opus_dred_decoder_init
functions.signature: int opus_dred_decoder_init(OpusDREDDecoder *dec);
functions.description: Initializes a previously-allocated OpusDREDDecoder state. Returns OPUS_OK or an error code.
requirements: dec must point to at least opus_dred_decoder_get_size() bytes of allocated memory

functions.name: opus_dred_decoder_destroy
functions.signature: void opus_dred_decoder_destroy(OpusDREDDecoder *dec);
functions.description: Frees an OpusDREDDecoder allocated by opus_dred_decoder_create.
requirements: dec must be a pointer returned by opus_dred_decoder_create or NULL

functions.name: opus_dred_decoder_ctl
functions.signature: int opus_dred_decoder_ctl(OpusDREDDecoder *dred_dec, int request, ...);
functions.description: Issues a control (CTL) request on an Opus DRED decoder using CTL macros from opus_genericctls or opus_decoderctls. Returns OPUS_OK or an error code.
requirements: dred_dec must be a valid, initialized OpusDREDDecoder
request and variadic arguments must match a documented CTL macro

functions.name: opus_dred_get_size
functions.signature: int opus_dred_get_size(void);
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to hold an OpusDRED state (DRED packet state).

functions.name: opus_dred_alloc
functions.signature: OpusDRED *opus_dred_alloc(int *error);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a new OpusDRED state. Returns a pointer on success and writes OPUS_OK to error; returns NULL on failure with an error code.
requirements: error must be a valid pointer if error reporting is desired

functions.name: opus_dred_free
functions.signature: void opus_dred_free(OpusDRED *dec);
functions.description: Frees an OpusDRED state allocated by opus_dred_alloc.
requirements: dec must be a pointer returned by opus_dred_alloc or NULL

functions.name: opus_dred_parse
functions.signature: int opus_dred_parse(OpusDREDDecoder *dred_dec, OpusDRED *dred, const unsigned char *data, opus_int32 len, opus_int32 max_dred_samples, opus_int32 sampling_rate, int *dred_end, int defer_processing);
functions.description: Parses an Opus packet for DRED data. Optionally defers CPU-intensive processing. Returns the positive offset of the first decoded DRED samples, zero if no DRED is present, or an error code.
requirements: dred_dec must be a valid, initialized OpusDREDDecoder
dred must be a valid OpusDRED state
data points to the input payload
len is the number of bytes in data
max_dred_samples is the maximum number of DRED samples that may be needed (if available) at the provided sampling_rate
sampling_rate denotes the rate used for max_dred_samples; it need not match the decoder’s actual sampling rate
dred_end must be a valid pointer to receive the number of non-encoded (silence) samples between the DRED timestamp and the last DRED sample
defer_processing must be 0 or 1; if 1, opus_dred_process must be called to finish decoding

functions.name: opus_dred_process
functions.signature: int opus_dred_process(OpusDREDDecoder *dred_dec, const OpusDRED *src, OpusDRED *dst);
functions.description: Completes DRED decoding after a deferred parse. Often src and dst are the same DRED state. Returns an opus error code.
requirements: This function should be called only if opus_dred_parse() was called with defer_processing=1
dred_dec must be a valid, initialized OpusDREDDecoder
src must point to a valid OpusDRED state to process from
dst must point to a valid OpusDRED state to receive the updated state

functions.name: opus_decoder_dred_decode
functions.signature: int opus_decoder_dred_decode(OpusDecoder *st, const OpusDRED *dred, opus_int32 dred_offset, opus_int16 *pcm, opus_int32 frame_size);
functions.description: Decodes audio redundancy from an Opus DRED packet using a decoder, producing 16-bit interleaved PCM. Returns the number of decoded samples or an error code.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized OpusDecoder
dred must be a valid OpusDRED state
dred_offset is the position of the redundancy to decode (in samples before the beginning of the real audio data in the packet)
pcm must have space for frame_size*channels samples
frame_size must be a multiple of 2.5 ms

functions.name: opus_decoder_dred_decode24
functions.signature: int opus_decoder_dred_decode24(OpusDecoder *st, const OpusDRED *dred, opus_int32 dred_offset, opus_int32 *pcm, opus_int32 frame_size);
functions.description: Decodes audio redundancy from an Opus DRED packet using a decoder, producing 24-bit-range samples in 32-bit integers. Returns number of decoded samples or an error code.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized OpusDecoder
dred must be a valid OpusDRED state
dred_offset is in samples before the beginning of the real audio data in the packet
pcm must have space for frame_size*channels 32-bit samples
frame_size must be a multiple of 2.5 ms

functions.name: opus_decoder_dred_decode_float
functions.signature: int opus_decoder_dred_decode_float(OpusDecoder *st, const OpusDRED *dred, opus_int32 dred_offset, float *pcm, opus_int32 frame_size);
functions.description: Decodes audio redundancy from an Opus DRED packet using a decoder, producing floating-point PCM. Returns number of decoded samples or an error code.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized OpusDecoder
dred must be a valid OpusDRED state
dred_offset is in samples before the beginning of the real audio data in the packet
pcm must have space for frame_size*channels floats
frame_size must be a multiple of 2.5 ms

functions.name: opus_packet_parse
functions.signature: int opus_packet_parse(const unsigned char *data, opus_int32 len, unsigned char *out_toc, const unsigned char *frames[48], opus_int16 size[48], int *payload_offset);
functions.description: Parses an Opus packet into one or more frame pointers without copying frame data. Returns the number of frames.
requirements: data must point to a valid Opus packet
len is the size of data (bytes)
out_toc, if non-NULL, receives the TOC byte
frames array must have capacity for up to 48 pointers; returned pointers reference memory inside data and remain valid only as long as data is valid
size array must have capacity for up to 48 entries; receives sizes of encapsulated frames
payload_offset, if non-NULL, receives the byte offset of the payload within the packet

functions.name: opus_packet_get_bandwidth
functions.signature: int opus_packet_get_bandwidth(const unsigned char *data);
functions.description: Returns the bandwidth of an Opus packet as an OPUS_BANDWIDTH_* constant, or OPUS_INVALID_PACKET on invalid/corrupt input.
requirements: data must point to a valid Opus packet (at least 1 byte)

functions.name: opus_packet_get_samples_per_frame
functions.signature: int opus_packet_get_samples_per_frame(const unsigned char *data, opus_int32 Fs);
functions.description: Returns the number of samples per frame signaled by an Opus packet for the given sample rate.
requirements: data must contain at least one byte
Fs must be a multiple of 400 Hz, otherwise results may be inaccurate

functions.name: opus_packet_get_nb_channels
functions.signature: int opus_packet_get_nb_channels(const unsigned char *data);
functions.description: Returns the number of channels encoded in an Opus packet, or OPUS_INVALID_PACKET if the data is invalid or unsupported.
requirements: data must point to a valid Opus packet

functions.name: opus_packet_get_nb_frames
functions.signature: int opus_packet_get_nb_frames(const unsigned char packet[], opus_int32 len);
functions.description: Returns the number of frames contained in an Opus packet, or an error code.
requirements: packet must point to an Opus packet
len must be the packet length in bytes

functions.name: opus_packet_get_nb_samples
functions.signature: int opus_packet_get_nb_samples(const unsigned char packet[], opus_int32 len, opus_int32 Fs);
functions.description: Returns the total number of samples (per channel) contained in an Opus packet at the specified sample rate, or an error code.
requirements: packet must point to an Opus packet
len must be the packet length in bytes
Fs must be a multiple of 400 Hz, otherwise results may be inaccurate

functions.name: opus_packet_has_lbrr
functions.signature: int opus_packet_has_lbrr(const unsigned char packet[], opus_int32 len);
functions.description: Checks whether an Opus packet contains LBRR (redundant) data. Returns 1 if present, 0 otherwise, or an error code for invalid packets.
requirements: packet must point to an Opus packet
len must be the packet length in bytes

functions.name: opus_decoder_get_nb_samples
functions.signature: int opus_decoder_get_nb_samples(const OpusDecoder *dec, const unsigned char packet[], opus_int32 len);
functions.description: Returns the number of samples (per channel) that would be decoded from the given packet by the provided decoder configuration, or an error code.
requirements: dec must be a valid, initialized OpusDecoder
packet must point to an Opus packet
len must be the packet length in bytes

functions.name: opus_pcm_soft_clip
functions.signature: void opus_pcm_soft_clip(float *pcm, int frame_size, int channels, float *softclip_mem);
functions.description: Applies soft-clipping to float PCM to confine it to [-1, 1] with minimal distortion. Operates in-place and uses/updates per-channel soft-clip memory.
requirements: pcm must point to frame_size*channels floats and is modified in place
frame_size must be the number of samples per channel to process
channels must be the number of channels
softclip_mem must point to an array of at least channels floats and should be initialized to 0 for new streams

functions.name: opus_repacketizer_get_size
functions.signature: int opus_repacketizer_get_size(void);
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to hold an OpusRepacketizer state.

functions.name: opus_repacketizer_init
functions.signature: OpusRepacketizer *opus_repacketizer_init(OpusRepacketizer *rp);
functions.description: (Re)initializes an OpusRepacketizer state and clears any queued frames. Returns rp.
requirements: rp must point to memory at least opus_repacketizer_get_size() bytes
Must be called to reset the state when reaching 120 ms total duration or when changing packet configuration

functions.name: opus_repacketizer_create
functions.signature: OpusRepacketizer *opus_repacketizer_create(void);
functions.description: Allocates memory and initializes a new OpusRepacketizer.

functions.name: opus_repacketizer_destroy
functions.signature: void opus_repacketizer_destroy(OpusRepacketizer *rp);
functions.description: Frees an OpusRepacketizer allocated by opus_repacketizer_create.
requirements: rp must be a pointer returned by opus_repacketizer_create or NULL

functions.name: opus_repacketizer_cat
functions.signature: int opus_repacketizer_cat(OpusRepacketizer *rp, const unsigned char *data, opus_int32 len);
functions.description: Adds an Opus packet to the current repacketizer state for later extraction. Returns OPUS_OK on success or OPUS_INVALID_PACKET if incompatible/invalid or would exceed 120 ms.
requirements: rp must be a valid, initialized OpusRepacketizer
data must point to a valid Opus packet and remain valid until the next opus_repacketizer_init() or opus_repacketizer_destroy()
len is the number of bytes in the packet
All submitted packets since last init must have identical coding mode, audio bandwidth, frame size, and channel count (matching top 6 bits of first byte)
Total queued audio after adding must not exceed 120 ms; otherwise the packet is not added

functions.name: opus_repacketizer_out_range
functions.signature: opus_int32 opus_repacketizer_out_range(OpusRepacketizer *rp, int begin, int end, unsigned char *data, opus_int32 maxlen);
functions.description: Constructs a new Opus packet from a contiguous range of frames previously submitted via opus_repacketizer_cat(). Returns the total size of the output packet or an error code.
requirements: rp must be a valid, initialized OpusRepacketizer
begin and end must define a valid frame range: 0 <= begin < end <= opus_repacketizer_get_nb_frames(rp)
data must have at least maxlen bytes available
To guarantee success, maxlen should be at least 1276 for one frame, or 1277*(end-begin) for multiple frames, or the accumulated packet data size since last init

functions.name: opus_repacketizer_get_nb_frames
functions.signature: int opus_repacketizer_get_nb_frames(OpusRepacketizer *rp);
functions.description: Returns the total number of frames submitted to the repacketizer since the last initialization.
requirements: rp must be a valid, initialized OpusRepacketizer

functions.name: opus_repacketizer_out
functions.signature: opus_int32 opus_repacketizer_out(OpusRepacketizer *rp, unsigned char *data, opus_int32 maxlen);
functions.description: Constructs a single Opus packet containing all frames submitted since the last initialization. Returns the total size of the output packet or an error code.
requirements: rp must be a valid, initialized OpusRepacketizer
data must have at least maxlen bytes available
To guarantee success, maxlen should be at least 1277*opus_repacketizer_get_nb_frames(rp), or the accumulated packet data size since last init

functions.name: opus_packet_pad
functions.signature: int opus_packet_pad(unsigned char *data, opus_int32 len, opus_int32 new_len);
functions.description: Pads an Opus packet to a larger size, possibly rewriting the TOC sequence. Returns OPUS_OK on success or an error code.
requirements: data must point to a valid Opus packet buffer to be modified in place
len must be at least 1
new_len must be at least len

functions.name: opus_packet_unpad
functions.signature: opus_int32 opus_packet_unpad(unsigned char *data, opus_int32 len);

len must be at least 1

functions.name: opus_multistream_packet_pad

requirements: data must point to a valid Opus multistream packet buffer to be modified in place
len must be at least 1
new_len must be at least 1
nb_streams must be the number of streams (not channels) in the packet

functions.name: opus_multistream_packet_unpad
functions.signature: opus_int32 opus_multistream_packet_unpad(unsigned char *data, opus_int32 len, int nb_streams);

functions.name: opus_multistream_encoder_get_size
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT opus_int32 opus_multistream_encoder_get_size(int streams, int coupled_streams);
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to hold an OpusMSEncoder state for a given multistream configuration. Use this to size custom allocations before calling opus_multistream_encoder_init().
requirements: streams must be <= 255.
coupled_streams must be <= streams.
streams + coupled_streams must be <= 255.

functions.name: opus_multistream_surround_encoder_get_size
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT opus_int32 opus_multistream_surround_encoder_get_size(int channels, int mapping_family);
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to hold an OpusMSEncoder for a surround configuration derived from channels and mapping_family. Intended for use prior to initializing a surround multistream encoder.
requirements: unknown (no explicit constraints documented in this header for channels or mapping_family).
Caller must check for negative return values indicating an error.

functions.name: opus_multistream_encoder_create
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT OpusMSEncoder *opus_multistream_encoder_create(opus_int32 Fs, int channels, int streams, int coupled_streams, const unsigned char *mapping, int application, int *error) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(5);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes an Opus multistream encoder according to the provided channel mapping and application. On success returns a pointer to the new encoder and writes OPUS_OK to error. Must be destroyed with opus_multistream_encoder_destroy().
requirements: channels must be <= 255.
streams must be <= channels.
coupled_streams must be <= streams.
streams + coupled_streams must be <= channels.
mapping must point to an array of length channels (non-null; OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(5)).
The encoder does not allow coupled streams where one of the pair is unused in the mapping.
application must be one of: OPUS_APPLICATION_VOIP, OPUS_APPLICATION_AUDIO, OPUS_APPLICATION_RESTRICTED_LOWDELAY.
error must be a valid pointer if the caller wants the status code; on failure a non-OPUS_OK error code is stored there.
Caller must check the returned pointer for NULL and/or inspect *error before use.

functions.name: opus_multistream_surround_encoder_create
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT OpusMSEncoder *opus_multistream_surround_encoder_create(opus_int32 Fs, int channels, int mapping_family, int *streams, int *coupled_streams, unsigned char *mapping, int application, int *error) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(4) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(5) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(6);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a surround-aware Opus multistream encoder. It derives an appropriate stream layout and mapping for the given mapping_family, writing back streams, coupled_streams, and mapping. Must be destroyed with opus_multistream_encoder_destroy().
requirements: streams, coupled_streams, and mapping must be non-null (OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(4),(5),(6)).

unknown: Specific constraints on Fs, channels, mapping_family, and application are not documented in this header for the surround helper; typical Opus constraints likely apply but are not stated here.
error should be a valid pointer if the caller wants the status code; caller must check the returned pointer and/or *error.

functions.name: opus_multistream_encoder_init
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT int opus_multistream_encoder_init(OpusMSEncoder *st, opus_int32 Fs, int channels, int streams, int coupled_streams, const unsigned char *mapping, int application) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(6);
functions.description: Initializes a previously allocated OpusMSEncoder with the specified multistream configuration and application. Use when managing your own memory (e.g., after allocating st with the size from opus_multistream_encoder_get_size()).
requirements: st must point to writable memory of at least the size returned by opus_multistream_encoder_get_size(streams, coupled_streams) (non-null; OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1)).
channels must be <= 255.
streams must be <= channels.
coupled_streams must be <= streams.
streams + coupled_streams must be <= channels.
mapping must point to an array of length channels (non-null; OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(6)).
The encoder does not allow coupled streams where one of the pair is unused in the mapping.
application must be one of: OPUS_APPLICATION_VOIP, OPUS_APPLICATION_AUDIO, OPUS_APPLICATION_RESTRICTED_LOWDELAY.
Returns OPUS_OK (0) on success or a negative opus_errorcodes value on failure; caller must check the return value.
Use OPUS_RESET_STATE CTL to reset an initialized state instead of reinitializing memory.

functions.name: opus_multistream_surround_encoder_init
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT int opus_multistream_surround_encoder_init(OpusMSEncoder *st, opus_int32 Fs, int channels, int mapping_family, int *streams, int *coupled_streams, unsigned char *mapping, int application) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(5) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(6) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(7);
functions.description: Initializes a previously allocated OpusMSEncoder for surround, determining stream layout and filling out streams, coupled_streams, and mapping based on mapping_family.
requirements: st must be non-null (OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1)) and point to writable memory sufficient for an OpusMSEncoder.
streams, coupled_streams, and mapping must be non-null (OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(5),(6),(7)).
unknown: Specific limits on Fs, channels, mapping_family, and application for this surround helper are not documented here.
Returns OPUS_OK on success or a negative opus_errorcodes value on failure; caller must check the return value.

functions.name: opus_multistream_encode
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT int opus_multistream_encode(OpusMSEncoder *st, const opus_int16 *pcm, int frame_size, unsigned char *data, opus_int32 max_data_bytes) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(2) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(4);
functions.description: Encodes a single multistream Opus frame from interleaved 16-bit PCM into a single output packet containing one Opus packet per stream.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized multistream encoder (non-null).
pcm must be non-null and contain frame_size*channels interleaved samples (int16).
frame_size must be a valid Opus frame size for the encoder’s sample rate. Examples at 48 kHz: 120, 240, 480, 960, 1920, 2880. Durations <10 ms prevent LPC/hybrid modes.
data must be non-null and large enough to hold at least max_data_bytes bytes.
max_data_bytes sets an upper bound on output size; bitrate should be controlled via OPUS_SET_BITRATE rather than solely via this limit.
Returns encoded packet length (bytes) on success or a negative opus_errorcodes value on failure; caller must check the return value.

functions.name: opus_multistream_encode24
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT int opus_multistream_encode24(OpusMSEncoder *st, const opus_int32 *pcm, int frame_size, unsigned char *data, opus_int32 max_data_bytes) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(2) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(4);
functions.description: Encodes a multistream Opus frame from interleaved 24-bit-depth PCM represented in 32-bit integers into a single output packet.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized multistream encoder (non-null).
pcm must be non-null and contain frame_size*channels interleaved samples as 32-bit integers representing (or slightly exceeding) 24-bit values.
frame_size must be a valid Opus frame size for the encoder’s sample rate (e.g., at 48 kHz: 120, 240, 480, 960, 1920, 2880).
data must be non-null and large enough for at least max_data_bytes bytes.
Returns encoded packet length (bytes) on success or a negative opus_errorcodes value on failure; caller must check the return value.

functions.name: opus_multistream_encode_float
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT int opus_multistream_encode_float(OpusMSEncoder *st, const float *pcm, int frame_size, unsigned char *data, opus_int32 max_data_bytes) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(2) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(4);
functions.description: Encodes a multistream Opus frame from interleaved floating-point PCM into a single output packet. Nominal input range is [-1.0, +1.0], though extended ranges are accepted.
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized multistream encoder (non-null).
pcm must be non-null and contain frame_size*channels interleaved float samples. Normal range is +/-1.0; samples outside this range may clip on integer decoders.
frame_size must be a valid Opus frame size for the encoder’s sample rate (e.g., at 48 kHz: 120, 240, 480, 960, 1920, 2880). Durations <10 ms prevent LPC/hybrid modes.
data must be non-null and large enough for at least max_data_bytes bytes.
Returns encoded packet length (bytes) on success or a negative opus_errorcodes value on failure; caller must check the return value.

functions.name: opus_multistream_encoder_destroy
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT void opus_multistream_encoder_destroy(OpusMSEncoder *st);
functions.description: Frees an OpusMSEncoder previously allocated by opus_multistream_encoder_create() or equivalent allocation. Safe resource cleanup for the multistream encoder.
requirements: st must be a pointer to an OpusMSEncoder previously allocated/initialized for multistream encoding.
Do not use st after this call (no further API calls on the destroyed object).
Caller must not double-destroy the same encoder pointer.

functions.name: opus_multistream_encoder_ctl
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT int opus_multistream_encoder_ctl(OpusMSEncoder *st, int request, ... ) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1);
functions.description: Performs a control (CTL) operation on a multistream encoder. Requests and arguments are typically generated by convenience macros from opus_genericctls, opus_encoderctls, or opus_multistream_ctls (e.g., to set bitrate or retrieve per-stream encoder states).
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized multistream encoder (non-null).
request and variadic arguments must correspond to a supported CTL macro; improper types/values result in errors.
Returns OPUS_OK on success or a negative opus_errorcodes value on failure; caller must check the return value.

functions.name: opus_multistream_decoder_get_size
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT opus_int32 opus_multistream_decoder_get_size(int streams, int coupled_streams);
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to hold an OpusMSDecoder state for the given multistream layout. Use this for custom allocations before calling opus_multistream_decoder_init().
requirements: streams must be <= 255.
coupled_streams must be <= streams.
streams + coupled_streams must be <= 255.
On error, a negative opus_errorcodes value is returned; callers must check for negative return values before using the size.

functions.name: opus_multistream_decoder_create
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT OpusMSDecoder *opus_multistream_decoder_create(opus_int32 Fs, int channels, int streams, int coupled_streams, const unsigned char *mapping, int *error) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(5);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes an Opus multistream decoder according to the provided output channel mapping. On success returns a pointer to the new decoder and writes OPUS_OK to error. Must be destroyed with opus_multistream_decoder_destroy().
requirements: channels must be <= 255 (output channels).
streams must be <= 255.
coupled_streams must be <= streams.
streams + coupled_streams must be <= 255.
mapping must point to an array of length channels (non-null; OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(5)).
error must be a valid pointer if the caller wants the status code; caller must check the returned pointer and/or *error.

functions.name: opus_multistream_decoder_init
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT int opus_multistream_decoder_init(OpusMSDecoder *st, opus_int32 Fs, int channels, int streams, int coupled_streams, const unsigned char *mapping) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(6);
functions.description: Initializes a previously allocated OpusMSDecoder with the specified multistream configuration and output mapping. Use when managing your own memory (e.g., after allocating st with the size from opus_multistream_decoder_get_size()).
requirements: st must point to writable memory of at least the size returned by opus_multistream_decoder_get_size(streams, coupled_streams) (non-null; OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1)).
channels must be <= 255 (output channels).
streams must be <= 255.
coupled_streams must be <= streams.
streams + coupled_streams must be <= 255.
mapping must point to an array of length channels (non-null; OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(6)).
Returns OPUS_OK (0) on success or a negative opus_errorcodes value on failure; caller must check the return value.
Use OPUS_RESET_STATE CTL to reset an initialized state instead of reinitializing memory.

functions.name: opus_multistream_decode
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT int opus_multistream_decode(OpusMSDecoder *st, const unsigned char *data, opus_int32 len, opus_int16 *pcm, int frame_size, int decode_fec) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(4);
functions.description: Decodes a multistream Opus packet into interleaved 16-bit PCM. Supports packet loss concealment (data==NULL) and optional in-band FEC (decode_fec=1).
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized multistream decoder (non-null).
pcm must be non-null and have space for frame_size*channels int16 samples.
data may be NULL to indicate packet loss; otherwise it must point to a buffer of length len bytes.
len is the number of bytes in data when data is not NULL.
frame_size is the number of samples per channel available in pcm; if less than the maximum packet duration (120 ms; 5760 at 48 kHz), some packets cannot be decoded.
For PLC (data==NULL) or FEC (decode_fec==1), frame_size must exactly match the duration of audio missing, and must be a multiple of 2.5 ms.
decode_fec must be 0 or 1.
Returns the number of samples decoded per channel on success, or a negative opus_errorcodes value on failure; caller must check the return value.

functions.name: opus_multistream_decode24
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT int opus_multistream_decode24(OpusMSDecoder *st, const unsigned char *data, opus_int32 len, opus_int32 *pcm, int frame_size, int decode_fec) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(4);
functions.description: Decodes a multistream Opus packet into interleaved 24-bit-depth audio represented in 32-bit integers. Supports PLC (data==NULL) and optional in-band FEC (decode_fec=1).
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized multistream decoder (non-null).
pcm must be non-null and have space for frame_size*channels 32-bit samples representing (or slightly exceeding) 24-bit values.
data may be NULL to indicate packet loss; otherwise it must point to a buffer of length len bytes.
len is the number of bytes in data when data is not NULL.

frame_size constraints are the same as opus_multistream_decode: if less than 120 ms (5760 at 48 kHz), some packets cannot be decoded; for PLC/FEC, it must exactly match the missing duration and be a multiple of 2.5 ms.
decode_fec must be 0 or 1.
Returns the number of samples decoded per channel on success, or a negative opus_errorcodes value on failure; caller must check the return value.

functions.name: opus_multistream_decode_float
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT int opus_multistream_decode_float(OpusMSDecoder *st, const unsigned char *data, opus_int32 len, float *pcm, int frame_size, int decode_fec) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(4);
functions.description: Decodes a multistream Opus packet into interleaved floating-point PCM. Supports PLC (data==NULL) and optional in-band FEC (decode_fec=1).
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized multistream decoder (non-null).
pcm must be non-null and have space for frame_size*channels float samples.
data may be NULL to indicate packet loss; otherwise it must point to a buffer of length len bytes.
len is the number of bytes in data when data is not NULL.

frame_size constraints are the same as opus_multistream_decode: if less than 120 ms (5760 at 48 kHz), some packets cannot be decoded; for PLC/FEC, it must exactly match the missing duration and be a multiple of 2.5 ms.
decode_fec must be 0 or 1.
Returns the number of samples decoded per channel on success, or a negative opus_errorcodes value on failure; caller must check the return value.

functions.name: opus_multistream_decoder_ctl
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT int opus_multistream_decoder_ctl(OpusMSDecoder *st, int request, ... ) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1);
functions.description: Performs a control (CTL) operation on a multistream decoder. Requests and arguments are typically generated by convenience macros from opus_genericctls, opus_decoderctls, or opus_multistream_ctls (e.g., to get/modify decoder settings or retrieve per-stream decoder states).
requirements: st must be a valid, initialized multistream decoder (non-null).
request and variadic arguments must correspond to a supported CTL macro; improper types/values result in errors.
Returns OPUS_OK on success or a negative opus_errorcodes value on failure; caller must check the return value.

functions.name: opus_multistream_decoder_destroy
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT void opus_multistream_decoder_destroy(OpusMSDecoder *st);
functions.description: Frees an OpusMSDecoder previously allocated by opus_multistream_decoder_create() or equivalent allocation. Safe resource cleanup for the multistream decoder.
requirements: st must be a pointer to an OpusMSDecoder previously allocated/initialized for multistream decoding.
Do not use st after this call (no further API calls on the destroyed object).
Caller must not double-destroy the same decoder pointer.

functions.name: opus_projection_ambisonics_encoder_get_size
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT opus_int32 opus_projection_ambisonics_encoder_get_size(int channels, int mapping_family);
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to allocate an OpusProjectionEncoder for the given channel count and mapping family. Use this when allocating encoder memory manually.
requirements: channels must be no more than 255 (per documentation).
mapping_family selects the projection mapping; valid values depend on library-defined families (exact set not specified here).
On success returns size in bytes; on error returns a negative opus error code.

functions.name: opus_projection_ambisonics_encoder_create
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT OpusProjectionEncoder *opus_projection_ambisonics_encoder_create(opus_int32 Fs, int channels, int mapping_family, int *streams, int *coupled_streams, int application, int *error) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(4) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(5);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a projection (Ambisonics) Opus encoder. Returns a pointer to the encoder or NULL on failure; error receives the status. Use opus_projection_encoder_destroy to free.
requirements: channels must be at most 255.
streams must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the total number of encoded streams.
coupled_streams must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the number of coupled (2-channel) streams.
application must be one of: OPUS_APPLICATION_VOIP, OPUS_APPLICATION_AUDIO, or OPUS_APPLICATION_RESTRICTED_LOWDELAY.
error must be a non-NULL pointer to receive #OPUS_OK or an error code on failure.
The input channel count may exceed streams + coupled_streams (encoded channels).
Call opus_projection_encoder_destroy() to release the returned encoder.

functions.name: opus_projection_ambisonics_encoder_init
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT int opus_projection_ambisonics_encoder_init(OpusProjectionEncoder *st, opus_int32 Fs, int channels, int mapping_family, int *streams, int *coupled_streams, int application) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(5) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(6);
functions.description: Initializes a previously allocated OpusProjectionEncoder with Ambisonics projection settings. Intended for custom allocation. Returns OPUS_OK or a negative error code.
requirements: st must be a non-NULL pointer to memory of at least opus_projection_ambisonics_encoder_get_size(channels, mapping_family) bytes.
channels must be at most 255.
streams must be non-NULL; returns the total number of streams to encode; must be no more than the number of channels.
coupled_streams must be non-NULL; returns number of coupled streams; must be no larger than total number of streams.
The total encoded channels (streams + coupled_streams) must be no more than the number of input channels.
application must be one of: OPUS_APPLICATION_VOIP, OPUS_APPLICATION_AUDIO, or OPUS_APPLICATION_RESTRICTED_LOWDELAY.
Use OPUS_RESET_STATE CTL to reset an already initialized state.

functions.name: opus_projection_encode
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT int opus_projection_encode(OpusProjectionEncoder *st, const opus_int16 *pcm, int frame_size, unsigned char *data, opus_int32 max_data_bytes) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(2) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(4);
functions.description: Encodes one frame of interleaved 16-bit PCM using a projection Opus encoder. Writes the encoded packet to data and returns the packet length in bytes, or a negative error code.
requirements: st must be a non-NULL, initialized OpusProjectionEncoder.
pcm must be non-NULL and contain frame_size*channels interleaved samples (channels as configured at init/create).
frame_size must be a valid Opus frame size for the encoder sampling rate (e.g., at 48 kHz one of 120, 240, 480, 960, 1920, 2880).
data must be non-NULL and have capacity for at least max_data_bytes bytes.
max_data_bytes specifies the available space and acts as an upper bound for the produced packet size.
Providing frame durations <10 ms is allowed but may restrict encoder modes (not an error).

functions.name: opus_projection_encode24
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT int opus_projection_encode24(OpusProjectionEncoder *st, const opus_int32 *pcm, int frame_size, unsigned char *data, opus_int32 max_data_bytes) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(2) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(4);
functions.description: Encodes one frame of interleaved 24-bit-depth PCM represented in 32-bit integers using a projection Opus encoder. Returns the encoded packet length in bytes, or a negative error code.
requirements: st must be a non-NULL, initialized OpusProjectionEncoder.
pcm must be non-NULL and contain frame_size*channels interleaved samples representing (or slightly exceeding) 24-bit values.
frame_size must be a valid Opus frame size for the encoder sampling rate (e.g., at 48 kHz: 120, 240, 480, 960, 1920, 2880).
data must be non-NULL and have capacity for at least max_data_bytes bytes.
max_data_bytes sets the maximum number of bytes to write.

functions.name: opus_projection_encode_float
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT int opus_projection_encode_float(OpusProjectionEncoder *st, const float *pcm, int frame_size, unsigned char *data, opus_int32 max_data_bytes) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(2) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(4);
functions.description: Encodes one frame of interleaved floating-point PCM using a projection Opus encoder. Input is expected in +/-1.0 range (extended range supported with caveats). Returns the encoded packet length in bytes, or a negative error code.
requirements: st must be a non-NULL, initialized OpusProjectionEncoder.
pcm must be non-NULL and contain frame_size*channels interleaved samples; normal range +/-1.0 (values outside may be clipped by integer decoders).
frame_size must be a valid Opus frame size for the encoder sampling rate (e.g., at 48 kHz: 120, 240, 480, 960, 1920, 2880).
data must be non-NULL and have capacity for at least max_data_bytes bytes.
max_data_bytes sets the maximum number of bytes to write.

functions.name: opus_projection_encoder_destroy
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT void opus_projection_encoder_destroy(OpusProjectionEncoder *st);
functions.description: Frees an OpusProjectionEncoder created with opus_projection_ambisonics_encoder_create.
requirements: st must point to an OpusProjectionEncoder previously returned by opus_projection_ambisonics_encoder_create.
Must not be used after being destroyed.

functions.name: opus_projection_encoder_ctl
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT int opus_projection_encoder_ctl(OpusProjectionEncoder *st, int request, ...) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(1);
functions.description: Applies a control (CTL) request to a projection Opus encoder via variadic arguments, typically using convenience macros (generic, encoder, multistream, or projection CTLs). Returns OPUS_OK or a negative error code.
requirements: st must be a non-NULL, initialized OpusProjectionEncoder.
request and varargs must match one of the documented CTL macros from opus_genericctls, opus_encoderctls, opus_multistream_ctls, or opus_projection_ctls.
For GET-style CTLs, provide writable pointers of the correct type and size; for SET-style CTLs, provide values of the correct type/range as defined by the specific CTL.

functions.name: opus_projection_decoder_get_size
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT opus_int32 opus_projection_decoder_get_size(int channels, int streams, int coupled_streams);
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to allocate an OpusProjectionDecoder for the given output channel count and coded stream configuration.
requirements: channels must be no more than 255.
streams must be no more than 255.
coupled_streams must be no larger than streams.
The total coded channels (streams + coupled_streams) must be no more than 255.
On success returns size in bytes; on error returns a negative opus error code.

functions.name: opus_projection_decoder_create
functions.signature: OPUS_EXPORT OPUS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT OpusProjectionDecoder *opus_projection_decoder_create(opus_int32 Fs, int channels, int streams, int coupled_streams, unsigned char *demixing_matrix, opus_int32 demixing_matrix_size, int *error) OPUS_ARG_NONNULL(5);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a projection Opus decoder with the provided demixing matrix. Returns a decoder pointer or NULL; error receives the status. Use opus_projection_decoder_destroy to free.
requirements: channels must be at most 255 and may differ from coded channels.
streams must be no more than 255.
coupled_streams must be no larger than streams.
The total coded channels (streams + coupled_streams) must be no more than 255.
demixing_matrix must be a non-NULL pointer to a buffer of demixing_matrix_size bytes describing the mapping from coded to output channels (format per opus_projection_ctls).
demixing_matrix_size specifies the size in bytes of the demixing matrix.
error must be a pointer to receive #OPUS_OK or an error code on failure.

import os
import random
import struct
from typing import List

# This generator targets fuzzers that consume FUZZ_PARAM_STR() and FUZZ_PARAM(unsigned int)
# to synthesize PCM and configuration. We will emit a compact, structured raw-byte blob
# that contains:
# - A header with plausible Opus encoder/decoder configuration (Fs, channels)
# - Several PCM segments in multiple representations reused by the stubs
# - Extra random payload for packet bytes and demixing matrices
# The fuzzer stubs read FUZZ_PARAM_STR() multiple times; many harnesses iterate
# over a single input buffer for all FUZZ_PARAM_STR() calls. To maximize validity,
# we pack enough data and entropy while keeping under 4096 bytes.

RATES = [8000, 12000, 16000, 24000, 48000]
FRAME_MULTS = [1, 2, 4, 8]


def _pack_header(Fs: int, channels: int) -> bytes:
    # Simple header: magic + Fs + channels + padding
    return b"OPUSGEN\x00" + struct.pack("<I B", Fs, channels) + b"\x00\x00\x00"


def _gen_pcm_int16(seed: random.Random, samples: int) -> bytes:
    # Generate interleaved int16 PCM in a musically plausible pattern mixed with noise
    out = bytearray()
    # Sine-like low frequency plus random noise
    freq_choices = [110, 220, 440, 880]
    freq = seed.choice(freq_choices)
    phase = seed.random() * 2.0 * 3.141592653589793
    # Assume 48k base for shape; actual encode uses only values range-wise
    sr = 48000
    for n in range(samples):
        t = (phase + 2.0 * 3.141592653589793 * freq * (n / sr))
        s = int(12000 * (0.6 * (random.Random(seed.randint(0, 1 << 30)).random() * 2 - 1) + 0.4 * (0.5 * (1 if int(t) % 2 == 0 else -1))))
        # Clamp to int16
        if s > 32767:
            s = 32767
        if s < -32768:
            s = -32768
        out += struct.pack('<h', s)
    return bytes(out)


def _gen_pcm_int32_24bit(seed: random.Random, samples: int) -> bytes:
    # Generate 24-bit range values in 32-bit container
    out = bytearray()
    for _ in range(samples):
        # 24-bit value centered, mix of small and large amplitudes
        if seed.random() < 0.5:
            v = seed.randint(-1 << 15, (1 << 15) - 1) << 8
        else:
            v = seed.randint(-1 << 23, (1 << 23) - 1)
        out += struct.pack('<i', v)
    return bytes(out)


def _gen_pcm_float(seed: random.Random, samples: int) -> bytes:
    # Floats in [-1,1] with occasional excursions up to ~2.0 to exercise clipping
    out = bytearray()
    for _ in range(samples):
        base = seed.random() * 2.0 - 1.0
        if seed.random() < 0.1:
            base *= 2.0
        out += struct.pack('<f', float(base))
    return bytes(out)


def _gen_packet_bytes(seed: random.Random, max_len: int) -> bytes:
    # Generate a variety of likely-valid Opus TOC-like first bytes and payload lengths
    # We don't need strict validity; parser/decoder fuzzers accept failures, but we
    # try to skew towards plausible small packets.
    out = bytearray()
    count = max(1, max_len // 50)
    for _ in range(count):
        # TOC-like first byte: mode/bandwidth bits randomized
        toc = seed.randrange(0, 256)
        size = seed.randrange(1, 60)
        out.append(toc)
        out += os.urandom(size)
    return bytes(out)[:max_len]


def _gen_demixing_matrix(seed: random.Random, max_len: int) -> bytes:
    # Random matrix bytes; projection decoder only needs size and pointer
    ln = seed.randrange(16, max_len + 1)
    return seed.randbytes(ln) if hasattr(seed, 'randbytes') else bytes([seed.randrange(256) for _ in range(ln)])


def _choose_valid_frame_size(Fs: int, seed: random.Random) -> int:
    base = Fs // 400
    return base * seed.choice(FRAME_MULTS)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rnd = random.Random(seed)

    # Pick a consistent, valid encoder/decoder config used by many stubs
    Fs = rnd.choice(RATES)
    channels = 1 + (rnd.randrange(0, 2))  # 1 or 2

    # Frame sizes and sample counts kept modest to satisfy stub limits
    frame_size = _choose_valid_frame_size(Fs, rnd)
    total_samples = min(1024, frame_size * channels)
    if total_samples <= 0:
        total_samples = channels * (Fs // 400)

    # Build sections
    header = _pack_header(Fs, channels)

    pcm16 = _gen_pcm_int16(rnd, total_samples)
    pcm32 = _gen_pcm_int32_24bit(rnd, total_samples)
    pcmf = _gen_pcm_float(rnd, total_samples)

    # Packet bytes for decode and repacketizer paths
    pkt = _gen_packet_bytes(rnd, 512)

    # Demixing matrix for projection decoder create/init
    matrix = _gen_demixing_matrix(rnd, 128)

    # Some extra entropy for miscellaneous FUZZ_PARAM_STR consumers
    extra = rnd.randbytes(256) if hasattr(rnd, 'randbytes') else bytes([rnd.randrange(256) for _ in range(256)])

    # Layout: [header][pcm16][pcm32][pcmf][packet][matrix][extra]
    blob = header + pcm16 + pcm32 + pcmf + pkt + matrix + extra

    # Ensure <= 4096 bytes
    return blob[:4096]

import random
import struct
from typing import List

# This generator produces plausible Opus packet payloads for decoders and
# packet utilities. It focuses on creating valid-looking TOC bytes and simple
# SILK/LC/MDCT frame arrangements, CBR/framesize variations, and both mono/stereo
# indications. Lengths are kept small (<=512) since fuzzers cap sizes.
#
# We do not attempt full Opus bitstream compliance; however, packets are
# constructed to exercise different parsing branches (TOC config, frame count
# codes, padding, VBR/CBR size fields, FEC/LBRR flags, etc.) while remaining
# self-consistent at the container level so functions like opus_packet_parse,
# opus_packet_get_* and decoders receive structurally valid inputs frequently.

# Helper: build a TOC byte
# TOC layout (RFC 6716):
#  bits 7..5: config (mode/bandwidth)
#  bits 4..3: frame size index
#  bit 2:     frame count code (0:1 frame, 1: multiple)
#  bits 1..0: Stereo + padding per code (simplified here; we choose common patterns)
# In practice, only certain combinations are valid; we choose known-good sets.

# Predefined plausible TOC configurations for single-stream packets.
# Values chosen to cover NB/WB/SWB/FB and SILK/CELT/hybrid modes commonly seen.
TOC_CONFIGS = [
    0x00,  # SILK NB
    0x08,  # SILK MB
    0x10,  # SILK WB
    0x18,  # Hybrid SWB
    0x20,  # Hybrid FB
    0x28,  # CELT NB
    0x30,  # CELT WB
    0x38,  # CELT FB
]

# Frame size indices 0..3 map to Fs/400, /200, /100, /50 (Opus spec)
FS_INDICES = [0, 1, 2, 3]

# Code 0: one frame; Code 1: two frames CBR; Code 2: two frames VBR; Code 3: many frames
FRAME_COUNT_CODES = [0, 1, 2, 3]

# For many-frames code, number of frames 1..48 (we choose small numbers typically)

def _u8(x: int) -> bytes:
    return struct.pack('B', x & 0xFF)


def _random_bytes(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    return bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(n))


def _gen_sizes_cbr(total_len: int, nframes: int) -> List[int]:
    # Equal sizes for CBR frames, ensure at least 1 byte per frame
    base = max(1, total_len // nframes)
    sizes = [base] * nframes
    # Adjust remainder into the last frame
    sizes[-1] = total_len - base * (nframes - 1)
    return sizes


def _gen_sizes_vbr(rng: random.Random, total_len: int, nframes: int) -> List[int]:
    # Split total_len randomly into nframes positive parts, with 1 byte minimum
    if total_len < nframes:
        sizes = [1] * nframes
        return sizes
    cuts = sorted(rng.sample(range(1, total_len), k=nframes - 1)) if nframes > 1 else []
    parts = []
    prev = 0
    for c in cuts + [total_len]:
        parts.append(max(1, c - prev))
        prev = c
    # Normalize if sum > total_len due to max(1,..)
    s = sum(parts)
    if s > total_len:
        # Reduce extras from the end
        i = len(parts) - 1
        while s > total_len and i >= 0:
            reducible = min(parts[i] - 1, s - total_len)
            if reducible > 0:
                parts[i] -= reducible
                s -= reducible
            i -= 1
    return parts


def _write_vbr_len(val: int) -> bytes:
    # Opus VBR code uses one or two bytes for frame length:
    # If len < 252: single byte; else 0xFC and then (len-252) as one byte.
    if val < 252:
        return _u8(val)
    else:
        return b"\xFC" + _u8(val - 252)


def _build_packet(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Choose structure
    config = rng.choice(TOC_CONFIGS)
    fs_idx = rng.choice(FS_INDICES)
    code = rng.choice(FRAME_COUNT_CODES)

    # Channel flag in TOC low bit for some modes is implicit; to exercise stereo paths,
    # we occasionally toggle the LSB. Not all combinations are meaningful but tolerated by parsers.
    stereo_flag = rng.choice([0, 1])

    toc = (config & 0xF8) | ((fs_idx & 0x3) << 3)
    # Frame count code occupies bits 1..0 in some interpretations; in Opus, code selection is
    # encoded after TOC, but the top-level framing byte(s) depend on code. We keep TOC coherent
    # and put code in the following header as per spec. Therefore leave toc low bits for stereo-like flag.
    toc |= (stereo_flag & 0x1)

    # Decide total packet target size (including headers after TOC)
    total_target = rng.randint(10, 200)  # modest size to keep decoders fast

    payload = bytearray()
    payload.append(toc)

    # Build frame data according to code
    if code == 0:
        # 1 frame: just append bytes
        nframes = 1
        frame_len = total_target - 1
        if frame_len < 1:
            frame_len = 1
        payload.extend(_random_bytes(rng, frame_len))
    elif code == 1:
        # 2 frames, CBR: no explicit sizes, just two equal chunks
        nframes = 2
        data_len = max(2, total_target - 1)  # at least 1 byte per frame
        sizes = _gen_sizes_cbr(data_len, nframes)
        # No extra header for CBR
        for s in sizes:
            payload.extend(_random_bytes(rng, s))
    elif code == 2:
        # 2 frames, VBR: frame length fields precede frames
        nframes = 2
        data_len = max(2, total_target - 1 - 1)  # reserve ~1 byte size field minimal
        sizes = _gen_sizes_vbr(rng, data_len, nframes)
        # VBR flag byte (set VBR bit). In real Opus, this is part of the code 2 header; we emulate minimal form.
        # Place a simple VBR marker so parsers expecting size bytes proceed.
        # Write size for first frame; second is implicit from remaining bytes.
        size_bytes = _write_vbr_len(sizes[0])
        payload.extend(size_bytes)
        payload.extend(_random_bytes(rng, sizes[0]))
        payload.extend(_random_bytes(rng, sizes[1]))
    else:
        # code == 3: arbitrary number of frames (1..8) with padding option and VBR/CBR choice
        nframes = rng.randint(1, 8)
        # First byte after TOC: code 3 table (frame count packed with VBR bit and padding bit)
        vbr = rng.choice([0, 1])
        pad = rng.choice([0, 1])
        fch = ((nframes & 0x3F) | (vbr << 7)) & 0xFF
        payload.append(fch)
        # Optional padding length field(s)
        pad_len = 0
        if pad:
            # Write padding as a series of 0xFF followed by remainder (spec-like). Keep small.
            pad_len = rng.randint(1, 8)
            rem = pad_len
            while rem >= 255:
                payload.append(255)
                rem -= 255
            payload.append(rem)
        # Compute remaining room for data
        header_so_far = len(payload)
        data_room = max(1, total_target - header_so_far - pad_len)
        if vbr:
            sizes = _gen_sizes_vbr(rng, data_room, nframes)
            # Write N-1 size fields
            for i in range(nframes - 1):
                payload.extend(_write_vbr_len(sizes[i]))
            # Frames
            for i in range(nframes):
                payload.extend(_random_bytes(rng, sizes[i]))
        else:
            sizes = _gen_sizes_cbr(data_room, nframes)
            # No size fields; just frames
            for s in sizes:
                payload.extend(_random_bytes(rng, s))
        # Append padding bytes if any
        if pad_len:
            payload.extend(b"\x00" * pad_len)

    # Occasionally add LBRR-like trailing bytes or FEC signal by modest extension
    if len(payload) < 30 and rng.random() < 0.3:
        extra = rng.randint(1, 10)
        payload.extend(_random_bytes(rng, extra))

    # Ensure length bounds [1, 512]
    if len(payload) < 1:
        payload = bytearray(b"\x00")
    if len(payload) > 512:
        payload = bytearray(payload[:512])

    return bytes(payload)


def _gen_projection_matrix(rng: random.Random, channels: int, streams: int, coupled_streams: int) -> bytes:
    # For projection decoders, some fuzzers pass a demixing matrix buffer elsewhere.
    # Here we sometimes prepend a small blob that could serve as such in combined flows.
    rows = max(1, channels)
    cols = max(1, streams + coupled_streams)
    # Simple byte matrix, keep small
    size = min(64, rows * cols)
    return _random_bytes(rng, size)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # Choose which family of packet to generate
    kind = rng.choice([
        'simple_single',      # 1 frame
        'two_cbr',            # 2 frames CBR
        'two_vbr',            # 2 frames VBR
        'multi_mixed',        # many frames with optional padding and vbr flag
        'padded_single',      # single frame plus external padding
        'projection_like',    # prepend a small demixing-like blob then an opus packet
        'fec_hint',           # attempt to look like FEC/LBRR-bearing packet with extra bytes
    ])

    pkt = _build_packet(rng)

    if kind == 'padded_single':
        # Wrap existing packet with additional padding via zeroes at the end
        pad = rng.randint(1, 32)
        pkt = (pkt + (b"\x00" * pad))[:512]
    elif kind == 'projection_like':
        channels = rng.choice([1, 2, 4, 6])
        streams = rng.choice([1, 2, 3])
        coupled = rng.choice([0, 1, 2])
        mat = _gen_projection_matrix(rng, channels, streams, coupled)
        joined = (mat + pkt)
        pkt = joined[:512]
    elif kind == 'fec_hint':
        # Add a small random trailer to mimic presence of redundancy
        trailer = _random_bytes(rng, rng.randint(1, 16))
        pkt = (pkt + trailer)[:512]
    elif kind == 'two_cbr':
        # Rebuild forcing code path 1
        rng2 = random.Random(seed ^ 0xC0DE)
        # Force 2-frame CBR by crafting a packet of moderate size
        pkt = _build_packet(rng2)
    elif kind == 'two_vbr':
        rng3 = random.Random(seed ^ 0xBEEF)
        pkt = _build_packet(rng3)
    elif kind == 'multi_mixed':
        rng4 = random.Random(seed ^ 0xFACE)
        pkt = _build_packet(rng4)
    else:
        # simple_single already covered by base pkt
        pass

    # Ensure at least 1 byte and not exceeding 4096 (our cap is 512)
    if not pkt:
        pkt = b"\x00"
    if len(pkt) > 4096:
        pkt = pkt[:4096]

    return pkt
